src: 当地警方希望广大网友和社会各界如有相关线索，及时向格尔木警方和南京江宁警方提供，争取早日找到失联人员黄某某。
mt: The local police hope that if the vast number of netizens and all sectors of society have relevant clues, they will provide them to Golmud police and Nanjing Jiangning police in a timely manner, and strive to find the missing person, Huang, as soon as possible.
ref: The local police hope that the netizens and all circles of the society provide relevant clues, if any, to the police of Golmud and Nanjing in time, striving to find the lost person Huang XX early.

src: 同时，有关专家提示，游客在户外活动时要规范、理性、文明，随时留意路边警示标志，切勿冒险进入无人区，遇到突发情况，要及时报警。
mt: At the same time, relevant experts suggested that tourists should be standardized, rational, and civilized in their outdoor activities, pay attention to roadside warning signs at all times, do not venture into no man's land, and call the police in a timely manner in case of emergency.
ref: At the same time, the relevant experts suggest that tourists, when carrying out in outdoor activities, should act in a standardized, rational, civilized way , always pay attention to roadside warning signs, never venture into uninhabited areas, and promptly call the police under emergencies.

src: 俄罗斯举办阅兵式庆祝海军节-新华网
mt: Russia Holds Military Parade to Celebrate Navy Day - Xinhuanet
ref: Russia celebrates the Navy Day with military parade – www.xinhuanet.com

src: 7月26日，在俄罗斯圣彼得堡，舰艇列队参加海军节庆祝活动。
mt: On July 26, in St. Petersburg, Russia, ships lined up to participate in the Navy Day celebration.
ref: On July 26, ships paraded for the Navy Day celebration in St. Petersburg, Russia.

src: 新华社发（莫京娜摄）
mt: Xinhua News Agency (Photo by Mo Jingna)
ref: By Xinhua News Agency (Photo by Mogina)

src: 新华社莫斯科7月26日电（记者鲁金博）俄罗斯各舰队26日举行阅兵式庆祝海军节，纪念俄海军成立324周年。
mt: Xinhua News Agency, Moscow, July 26 (Reporter Lu Jinbo) Russian fleets held a military parade to celebrate Navy Day on July 26 to commemorate the 324th anniversary of the founding of the Russian Navy.
ref: Xinhua News Agency, MOSCOW, July 26 (reporter Lu Jinbo) – On the 26th, Russian fleets held a parade to celebrate the Navy Day and commemorate the 324th anniversary of the founding of the Russian Navy.

src: 当天，俄罗斯北海、波罗的海、黑海、里海和太平洋舰队分别在各自基地所在海域举行了阅兵式，共有1.5万军人、219艘各类舰艇和71架军用飞机参加。
mt: On the same day, Russia's North Sea, Baltic Sea, Black Sea, Caspian Sea, and Pacific Fleet held military parades in the waters where their respective bases are located, with a total of 15,000 soldiers, 219 ships of various types, and 71 military aircraft participating.
ref: On that day, Russia's North Sea, Baltic Sea, Black Sea, Caspian Sea and Pacific Fleet held parades in the seas where their respective bases are located, with the participation of 15,000 soldiers, 219 ships of all types, and 71 military aircrafts.

src: 俄总统、武装力量最高统帅普京出席了波罗的海舰队的阅兵式。
mt: Russian President and Commander - in - Chief of the Armed Forces Vladimir Putin attended the parade of the Baltic Fleet.
ref: Russian President and Supreme Commander of the Armed Forces Vladimir Putin attended the parade of the Baltic Fleet.

src: 约4000名军人、46艘舰艇和40余架战机参加了当地的阅兵式。
mt: About 4,000 soldiers, 46 ships, and more than 40 warplanes took part in the local military parade.
ref: Around 4,000 servicemen, 46 ships and more than 40 warplanes took part in the local parade.

src: 普京首先在位于波罗的海喀琅施塔得海军基地水域检阅了舰艇列队。
mt: Putin first reviewed the ship parade in the waters of the Kronstadt naval base in the Baltic Sea.
ref: Putin first reviewed the fleet in the waters of the Kronstadt Naval Base in the Baltic Sea.

src: 之后，他乘坐快艇抵达圣彼得堡市中心的涅瓦河水域并上岸，观看了在涅瓦河上举行的阅兵式。
mt: After that, he took a speedboat to the waters of the Neva River in the center of St. Petersburg and went ashore to watch the military parade on the Neva River.
ref: After that, he arrived at the waters of the Neva River in the center of St. Petersburg by speedboat and went ashore to watch the parade held on the Neva River.

src: 普京在阅兵式上发表讲话说，俄海军装备的现代化技术水平近年来持续提升，俄海军2020年将总共接收约40艘配备独特高超音速打击系统的新型舰艇。
mt: Speaking at the military parade, Putin said that the modern technical level of the Russian Navy's equipment has continued to improve in recent years, and that the Russian Navy will receive a total of about 40 new ships equipped with unique hypersonic strike systems in 2020.
ref: In his speech at the parade, Putin said that the modernization of Russian naval equipment has continued to improve in recent years and that the Russian Navy will receive a total of about 40 new ships equipped with unique hypersonic strike systems in 2020.

src: 另外，俄海军总司令叶夫梅诺夫日前在接受俄国防部机关报《红星报》采访时说，俄建造舰艇的计划得到了有效落实，2020年俄海军计划接收的新舰艇数量是近年来规模较大的。
mt: In addition, Yevmenov, the commander - in - chief of the Russian Navy, said in an interview with Red Star, the official newspaper of the Russian Defense Ministry, that Russia's plans to build ships have been effectively implemented, and that the number of new ships the Russian Navy plans to receive in 2020 is the largest in recent years.
ref: In addition, Russian Navy Commander-in-Chief Yevmenov said in an interview with Red Star, the newspaper of the Russian Ministry of Defense, that Russia's plan to build ships is being effectively implemented and the number of new ships the Russian Navy plans to receive in 2020 is the largest in recent years.

src: 1696年，沙皇彼得大帝着手组建海上舰队，开创了俄海军历史。
mt: In 1696, Tsar Peter the Great set out to form a maritime fleet, which started the history of the Russian Navy.
ref: In 1696, Tsar Peter the Great set out to build a naval fleet, starting the history of the Russian Navy.

src: 每年7月最后一个星期日是俄罗斯海军节。
mt: The Russian Navy Day is celebrated on the last Sunday of July every year.
ref: Russian Navy Day is celebrated every year on the last Sunday of July.

src: 针对疫情防控工作出现的新变化，自7月17日以来，新疆各级工会响应自治区总工会的号召，积极参与疫情防控工作。
mt: In view of the new changes in epidemic prevention and control, since July 17, trade unions at all levels in Xinjiang have responded to the call of the Federation of Trade Unions of the Autonomous Region and actively participated in epidemic prevention and control work.
ref: In consideration of the new changes in the epidemic prevention and control work, since July 17, the trade unions at all levels in Xinjiang have responded to the call of Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region Federation of Trade Unions to actively participated in the epidemic prevention and control work.

src: 天山南北工会干部、职工、劳动模范走进街道社区、居民群众中，开展送菜送药、消毒灭菌、宣传防疫知识等活动，服务职工群众，用实际行动彰显工会“硬核力量”。
mt: Trade union cadres, workers, and model workers in the north and south of Tianshan entered the streets, communities, and residents to carry out activities such as delivering food and medicine, disinfection and sterilization, and propagating knowledge about epidemic prevention, so as to serve the workers and the masses, and to demonstrate the "hard nuclear force" of trade unions with practical actions.
ref: The cadres, staff and model workers of the trade unions across Tianshan went into street communities and residents to carry out activities such as delivering vegetables and medicines, disinfecting and sterilizing, and propagating knowledge of epidemic prevention, serving the workers and masses, and demonstrating the "hard core power" of trade unions with practical actions.

src: 近日，乌鲁木齐市天山区总工会慰问组一行，将一批急需的疫情防控生活物资送到了12个隔离点的工作人员手中。
mt: Recently, the condolence group of the Tianshan District Federation of Trade Unions in Urumqi delivered a batch of urgently needed epidemic prevention and control living materials to the staff at 12 quarantine points.
ref: Recently, the condolence group of Urumqi Tianshan District Federation of Trade Unions sent a batch of urgently needed living materials for epidemic prevention and control to the workers in 12 isolation points.

src: 疫情发生后，天山区总第一时间投入经费105万余元，紧急下拨给23个直属基层工会。
mt: After the outbreak of the epidemic, Tianshan District immediately invested more than 1.05 million yuan, which was urgently allocated to 23 directly affiliated grass - roots trade unions.
ref: After the outbreak of COVID-19 epidemic, Tianshan District Federation of Trade Unions invested more than RMB 1.05 million in the first time, which was urgently allocated to 23 directly affiliated grass-roots trade unions.

src: 中建新疆建工一建党委副书记、工会主席赵相国接到公司关于疫情防控的通知后，主动请缨，选择留在单位值班，为职工保驾护航。
mt: After receiving the company's notice on epidemic prevention and control, Zhao Xiangguo, deputy secretary of the Party Committee and chairman of the trade union, volunteered to stay on duty in the unit to protect the workers.
ref: Zhao Xiangguo, deputy secretary of the Party Committee and chairman of the trade union of CSCEC Xinjiang Construction & Engineering Group No.1 Construction Co., Ltd., took the initiative to volunteer after receiving the notice of the company on epidemic prevention and control, and chose to stay on duty in the unit to escort the employees.

src: 他为居住在单位宿舍和新入职的职工送去做饭的炊具、食品及日用品，并组织人员每隔两天为他们送一次生活必备物资。
mt: He delivered cooking utensils, food, and daily necessities to the newly employed workers living in the dormitory of the unit, and organized the personnel to deliver essential supplies to them every two days.
ref: Zhao Xiangguo sent cooking utensils, food and daily necessities to the employees who lived in the dormitory and who joined the company newly, and organized personnel to send daily necessities to them every two days.

src: “7月21日起，对坚守战‘疫’一线的干部职工进行摸底，并采取线上下单、商家送货上门的方式，先行为乌鲁木齐地区704名一线职工群众补充购买防疫用品和生活物资。”
mt: "From July 21, the cadres and workers who adhere to the front line of the fight against the'epidemic 'will be surveyed, and 704 front - line workers in Urumqi will be provided with supplementary anti - epidemic supplies and living materials through online orders and door - to - door delivery by businesses."
ref: "From July 21, the trade unions found out the cadres and workers who stick to the front line of fighting against the 'COVID-19 epidemic', and supplemented and purchased epidemic prevention supplies and living materials for 704 front-line workers in Urumq by adopting online orders and merchants delivering goods to home. ”

src: 新疆交通运输工会负责人告诉记者，面对突发疫情，他们全力做好疫情防控服务保障、稳步推进交通运输发展各项工作，营造齐心战“疫”的浓厚氛围。
mt: The head of the Xinjiang Transportation Trade Union told reporters that in the face of the sudden epidemic, they made every effort to ensure epidemic prevention and control services, steadily promote the development of transportation, and create a strong atmosphere to fight the "epidemic" together.
ref: The person in charge of Xinjiang Transportation Trade Union told reporters that in the face of sudden occurrence of the COVID-19 epidemic, they made every effort to ensure epidemic prevention and control services, steadily push forward the development of transportation, and create a strong atmosphere of fighting against the 'COVID-19 epidemic' with one heart.

src: 当前正值夏季高温，各级工会紧盯疫情防控重点地区的一线职工，把“送清凉”关心关爱落到实处。
mt: At present, when the summer heat is high, trade unions at all levels keep an eye on front - line workers in key areas for epidemic prevention and control, and put "cool" care into practice.
ref: At present, because of the high temperature in summer, trade unions at all levels keep a close eye on the front-line workers in key areas of epidemic prevention and control, and put the care of "sending coolness and refreshing" into practice.

src: 7月19日，乌鲁木齐县总工会启动向疫情防控一线职工“送清凉”慰问活动，全县警务站、卡点和卫生系统收到了饮料、水果等慰问品。
mt: On July 19, the Urumqi County Federation of Trade Unions launched a condolence campaign to "send cool" to front - line workers in epidemic prevention and control, and the county's police stations, card points, and health systems received drinks, fruits, and other condolence items.
ref: On July 19, the Federation of Trade Unions Urumqi County launched a condolence activity of "sending cool and refreshing" to the front-line workers in epidemic prevention and control, and the police stations, checkpoints and health systems in the county received condolences such as drinks and fruits.

src: “工会干部要进一步提高政治站位、强化责任担当，用关怀温暖人心，用行动鼓舞斗志。
mt: "Trade union cadres should further improve their political standing, strengthen their responsibility, warm people's hearts with care, and inspire their fighting spirit with action.
ref: "The cadres of trade unions at all levels should further improve their political positions, strengthen their responsibilities, warm people's hearts with care, and inspire people's morale with actions.

src: 要充分发挥工会组织凝聚职工、团结职工的作用，做好疫情防控服务保障，积极维护广大职工的健康权益，把关爱送到一线职工身边。”
mt: We should give full play to the role of trade unions in rallying and uniting workers, do a good job in ensuring epidemic prevention and control services, actively safeguard the health rights and interests of workers, and send care to front - line workers. "
ref: The trade unions at all levels should give full play to the role of trade unions in rallying and uniting workers, do a good job in epidemic prevention and control services, actively safeguard the health rights and interests of workers, and send care to the front-line workers. ”

src: 自治区总工会相关负责人表示。
mt: Relevant person in charge of the Federation of Trade Unions of the Autonomous Region said.
ref: The relevant responsible person of the Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region Federation of Trade Unions said.

src: 2020年直招士官工作全面展开-新华网
mt: Direct recruitment of non - commissioned officers in full swing in 2020 - Xinhuanet
ref: 2020 Direct recruitment of non-commissioned officers in full swing - www.xinhuanet.com

src: 新华社北京7月26日电（记者贾启龙）军委政治工作部、军委国防动员部近日联合印发通知，部署展开2020年从普通高等学校毕业生中直接招收士官工作。
mt: Xinhua News Agency, Beijing, July 26 (Reporter Jia Qilong) - The Political Work Department of the Military Commission and the National Defense Mobilization Department of the Military Commission recently jointly issued a notice to deploy and launch the direct recruitment of non - commissioned officers from graduates of ordinary institutions of higher learning in 2020.
ref: Xinhua News Agency, Beijing, July 26 (reporter Jia Qilong) – The Political Work Department of the Military Commission, the National Defense Mobilization Department of the Military Commission jointly issued a notice recently to make deployment for the 2020 direct recruitment of non-commissioned officers from the graduates of general institutes of higher education.

src: 今年直招士官涵盖计算机、自动化、机械等64类270余个军地通用专业，重点加大无人机、航海、航空航天、电子信息、小语种等专业招收力度，招收规模相比去年增加近2000人。
mt: This year's direct recruitment of non - commissioned officers covers more than 270 general military and local majors in 64 categories, including computers, automation, and machinery, with emphasis on increasing the recruitment of unmanned aerial vehicles, navigation, aerospace, electronic information, minor languages, and other majors, and the recruitment scale has increased by nearly 2,000 compared to last year.
ref: The direct recruitment of non-commissioned officers this year will cover more than 270 general military specialties of 64 categories such as computer, automation, and machinery, and focus on the specialties like UAV, navigation, aerospace, electronic information, minority languages, and nearly 2000 more people will be recruited as compared with the last year.

src: 今年直招士官工作与义务兵征集同步组织实施，8月1日开始，9月30日结束。
mt: This year, the direct recruitment of non - commissioned officers was organized and implemented simultaneously with the recruitment of conscripts, which began on August 1 and ended on September 30.
ref: The direct recruitment of non-commissioned officers and the recruitment of compulsory servicemen will be organized and implemented simultaneously, starting on August 1 and completed on September 30.

src: 应征青年可以通过全国征兵网（网址：http://www.gfbzb.gov.cn）查询直招士官条件和各地招收专业分布情况，符合专业范围和招收条件的在线提交报名信息，并根据应征地兵役机关统一要求，参加体格检查、政治考核等后续招收工作。
mt: Through the National Conscription Network (website: http://www.gfbzb.gov.cn), young conscripts can inquire about the conditions for direct recruitment of non - commissioned officers and the distribution of recruitment specialties in various regions, submit registration information online if they meet the scope of specialties and recruitment conditions, and participate in the follow - up recruitment work such as medical examination and political assessment in accordance with the unified requirements of the land - requisitioned military service organs.
ref: Young applicants can check the conditions for direct recruitment of non-commissioned officers and the distribution of recruitment specialties around the country through the national conscription website (website: http://www.gfbzb.gov.cn), submit their registration information online if they meet the specialty scope and recruitment conditions, and participate in the follow-up recruitment work such as physical examination and political assessment according to the unified requirements of the military service organs of the conscription areas.

src: 因招收专业和计划限制未能被招收为士官的合格青年，可以参加义务兵征集，服义务兵役期满选取为士官时，在普通高等学校按规定学制就读的年数视同服役时间。
mt: Qualified young people who are unable to be recruited as non - commissioned officers due to enrollment majors and program restrictions may participate in the recruitment of conscripts, and when they are selected as non - commissioned officers at the end of their compulsory military service, the number of years of study in ordinary institutions of higher learning according to the prescribed academic system shall be regarded as the length of service.
ref: Qualified youths who are not recruited as non-commissioned officers due to the limitation of recruiting specialty and program can participate in the conscription of compulsory servicemen, if they are selected as non-commissioned officers upon the expiry of obligatory military service, the years of study in general institutions of higher education in accordance with the prescribed academic system will be considered as service time.

src: 今年士官招收工作由省级或地市级人民政府征兵办公室统一组织，报名潜力丰富专业将在综合衡量报名对象学历层次、在校期间专业课成绩、取得职业资格证书等情况基础上择优遴选；稀缺专业将面向本地符合专业要求、具备招收优势的院校定向对口招收。
mt: This year, the recruitment of non - commissioned officers will be uniformly organized by the conscription offices of provincial or prefectural and municipal people's governments, and majors with rich registration potential will be selected on the basis of merit on the basis of comprehensive measurement of the academic level of the applicants, the achievements of professional courses while in school, and the obtaining of professional qualification certificates; scarce majors will be targeted for local colleges and universities that meet professional requirements and have recruitment advantages.
ref: The recruitment of non-commissioned officers this year will be uniformly organized by the Conscription Office of the provincial or prefectural or municipal people’s government, for the specialties with rich registration potential, the best applicants will be selected by comprehensively measuring their educational level, scores of professional courses in college, and certificates of professional certificates, etc., for scarce specialties, the personnel will be recruited pertinently from the local colleges and universities which meet specialty requirements and have recruitment advantages.

src: 根据疫情常态化防控要求，今年直招士官原则上不安排自行报到，将与义务兵同步组织运输入营。
mt: According to the requirements of normalized epidemic prevention and control, this year's direct recruitment of non - commissioned officers will not arrange to report on their own in principle, and will organize transportation into the camp in tandem with conscripts.
ref: According to the requirements of the normal prevention and control of the pandemic, the non-commissioned officers directly recruited this year, in principle, won’t be arranged to report for duty by themselves, but will be synchronously organized and transported into the camp together with compulsory servicemen.

src: 直接招收士官入伍时间从2020年9月1日起算，部队下达士官任职命令的时间为2020年12月1日。
mt: The time for direct enlistment of non - commissioned officers will be calculated from September 1, 2020, and the time for the army to issue the order for non - commissioned officers to serve will be December 1, 2020.
ref: The time of enlistment of non-commissioned officers directly recruited will be calculated from September 1, 2020, and the service order will be issued by the army to non-commissioned officers on December 1, 2020.

src: 部队接收单位将科学制定入伍和专业训练方案，认真组织施训；训练完成后按照专业对口、招用一致的原则，将招收士官统一精准分配到对口专业技术岗位。
mt: The receiving units of the army will scientifically formulate enlistment and professional training programs, and conscientiously organize training; after the training is completed, the recruited non - commissioned officers will be uniformly and accurately assigned to the corresponding professional and technical positions in accordance with the principle of professional counterparts and consistent recruitment.
ref: Troop receiving units will develop enlistment and professional training programs scientifically and organize training in earnest; and then distribute the recruited non-commissioned officers to the technical posts of pertinent specialties uniformly and precisely.

src: 驻英使馆发言人：中国政府是网络安全的坚定维护者-中新网
mt: Spokesperson of the Embassy in the UK: The Chinese Government is a staunch defender of cyber security - chinanews.com
ref: Spokesman of Chinese Embassy in the UK: Chinese government is a staunch defender of cyber security – www.chinanews.com

src: 中新网7月26日电 据中国驻英国大使馆网站消息，25日，中国驻英国使馆发言人就有关网络攻击错误言论答记者问。
mt: chinanews.com, July 26 according to the website of the Chinese Embassy in the UK, the spokesperson of the Chinese Embassy in the UK answered a reporter's question on the wrong remarks about the cyber attack on July 25.
ref: Www.chinanews.com, July 26 - According to the news at the website of the Chinese Embassy in London, on the 25th day, the spokesman of the Chinese Embassy in London answered reporters' questions on the wrong remarks about cyber attacks.

src: 发言人强调，中国政府是网络安全的坚定维护者，一贯坚决反对并打击任何形式的网络攻击和网络犯罪。
mt: The spokesman stressed that the Chinese government is a staunch defender of cyber security and has always resolutely opposed and cracked down on any form of cyber attacks and cyber crimes.
ref: The spokesman stressed that the Chinese government is a staunch defender of cyber security and has always firmly opposed and combated any form of cyber attacks and cyber crimes.

src: 有记者提问：据媒体称，与中国有关的黑客组织曾干扰一家英国公司网络系统、向存有专利数据的英美技术公司发动攻击、入侵欧盟国家政府网络。
mt: A reporter asked: According to the media, China - related hacking groups have interfered with the network system of a British company, attacked British and American technology companies with patent data, and hacked into the government networks of EU countries.
ref: A reporter asked: As claimed by some media, some hacker organizations related to China have ever interfered with a British company's network systems, launched attacks on British and American technology companies that hold patent data, and hacked into government networks of European Union countries.

src: 发言人表示，中国政府是网络安全的坚定维护者，一贯坚决反对并打击任何形式的网络攻击和网络犯罪。
mt: The spokesman said that the Chinese government is a staunch defender of cyber security and has always resolutely opposed and cracked down on any form of cyber attacks and cyber crimes.
ref: The spokesman said that the Chinese government is a staunch defender of cyber security and has always firmly opposed and combated any form of cyber attacks and cyber crimes.

src: 网络空间虚拟性强，溯源难，行为体多样，在调查和定性网络事件的时候应拿出充分的证据，不能无端猜测。
mt: Cyberspace is highly virtual, difficult to trace its origins, and diverse actors, so when investigating and characterizing cyber events, sufficient evidence should be produced, and no groundless speculation should be allowed.
ref: For strong virtual nature, difficulty in source tracing, and diversified actors of cyberspace, we shall provide sufficient evidence, instead of resorting to unwarranted speculation, when investigating and determining the nature of network events.

src: 发言人称，以往的“棱镜门”等一系列事件证明，美国一直都在进行全球最大范围的网络窃密行动。
mt: The spokesman said that a series of events such as "Prism Gate" in the past proved that the United States has been carrying out the world's largest cyber espionage operation.
ref: The spokesman said that, the U.S. has been conducting the cyber-secrecy operation of the largest scope in the world, as evidenced by the past series of events such as Prism Event.

src: 维护网络空间的和平与稳定符合所有国家的共同利益。
mt: Maintaining peace and stability in cyberspace serves the common interests of all countries.
ref: Maintaining the peace and stability in cyberspace is in the common interest of all countries.

src: 发言人指出，中国在科技创新方面的成就不是偷来的、不是抢来的，而是通过自力更生、艰苦奋斗得来的。
mt: The spokesman pointed out that China's achievements in scientific and technological innovation were not stolen or stolen, but achieved through self - reliance and hard work.
ref: The spokesman pointed out that China's achievements in technology innovation are not stolen or robbed, but have been made through self-dependence and hard work.

src: 2019年中国通过《专利合作条约》(PCT)途径提交了约5.9万件专利申请，年增长率为10.6%，成为提交国际专利申请量最多的国家。
mt: In 2019, China filed about 59,000 patent applications through the Patent Cooperation Treaty (PCT), with an annual growth rate of 10.6%, making it the country with the largest number of international patent applications.
ref: In 2019, China submitted around 59,000 patent applications by means of Patent Cooperation Treaty (PCT), with an annual growth rate of 10.6%, becoming the country submitting the most international patent applications.

src: 中国已经成为创新和知识产权大国。
mt: China has become a major country in innovation and intellectual property rights.
ref: China has become a great power in innovation and intellectual property.

src: 乌鲁木齐免费核酸检测多数区已基本完成 高风险地区进行二次检测-中新网
mt: Most districts in Urumqi have basically completed secondary testing in high - risk areas - chinanews.com
ref: Free nucleic acid test has been basically completed in most areas of Urumqi, and secondary test is carried out in high-risk areas – www.chinanews.com

src: 中新网乌鲁木齐7月26日电 (记者 孙亭文 赵雅敏)乌鲁木齐市卫健委主任张卫26日在通报乌鲁木齐市最新疫情和核酸检测情况时称，目前，乌鲁木齐全市免费核酸检测工作多数区已基本完成。
mt: chinanews.com, Urumqi, July 26 (Reporters Sun Tingwen Zhao Yamin) Zhang Wei, director of the Urumqi Health Commission, reported on the latest epidemic situation and nucleic acid testing in Urumqi on July 26, saying that at present, most districts in Urumqi have basically completed free nucleic acid testing.
ref: Www.wlmq.chinanews.com, July 26 (reporters Sun Tingwen, Zhao Yamin) - Zhang Wei, Director of Urumqi Municipal Health Commission, said when reporting the latest pandemic and nucleic acid test on the 26th day that, at present, free nucleic acid test has been basically completed in most areas of Urumqi.

src: 国务院专家组和自治区、乌鲁木齐市专家正在根据核酸检测和流行病学调查结果，对疫情的发展做进一步评估。
mt: The expert group of the State Council and experts from the autonomous region and Urumqi are making further assessments of the development of the epidemic based on the results of nucleic acid testing and epidemiological investigation.
ref: The expert panel of the State Council and the experts of the Autonomous Region and Urumqi are carrying out further assessment on the development of the pandemic according to the results of nucleic acid test and epidemiology investigation.

src: 新疆维吾尔自治区新闻办公室26日召开新闻发布会通报新疆疫情和防控情况。
mt: The Information Office of the Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region held a press conference on the 26th to inform about the epidemic situation and prevention and control in Xinjiang.
ref: The Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region Information Office held a press conference on the 26th day to inform about the epidemic situation and prevention & control in Xinjiang.

src: 据他介绍，7月25日0时至24时，乌鲁木齐市新增新冠肺炎确诊病例22例(其中5例为无症状感染者转确诊病例) ，新增无症状感染者38例。
mt: According to him, from 0:00 to 24:00 on July 25, there were 22 new confirmed cases of new coronavirus pneumonia in Urumqi (of which 5 were confirmed cases of asymptomatic infections) and 38 new asymptomatic infections.
ref: As introduced by him, from 00:00 to 24:00 of July 25, Urumqi had 22 new confirmed cases of COVID-19 (including 5 confirmed cases transferred from the asymptomatic infection cases), and 38 new asymptomatic infection cases.

src: 截至7月25日24时，乌鲁木齐市现有确诊病例135例，无症状感染者147例。
mt: As of 24:00 on July 25, there were 135 confirmed cases and 147 asymptomatic infections in Urumqi.
ref: As of 24:00 of July 25, Urumqi had 135 confirmed cases and 147 asymptomatic infection cases.

src: 25日新增的无症状感染者也基本上都是通过全市免费核酸检测、主动筛查出来的。
mt: The new asymptomatic infections on the 25th were also basically detected through free nucleic acid testing and active screening in the city.
ref: The asymptomatic infection cases newly increased on the 25th day were basically discovered through the free nucleic acid test and initiative screening in the city.

src: 乌鲁木齐市卫健委主任张卫26日称，乌鲁木齐全市免费核酸检测工作多数区已基本完成。
mt: Zhang Wei, director of the Urumqi Municipal Health Commission, said on the 26th that most districts in Urumqi have basically completed free nucleic acid testing.
ref: Zhang Wei, Director of Urumqi Municipal Health Commission, said when reporting the latest pandemic and nucleic acid test on the 26th day that, at present, free nucleic acid test has been basically completed in most areas of Urumqi.

src: 他还说，从国内其他地区的经验看，影响核酸检测结果的因素很多，比如检测试剂灵敏度、受检测人员的感染时间和排毒时间、标本取材时受检测者配合情况(配合度差可能导致标本没有取到位)以及检测环境、检验人员的操作熟练程度等。
mt: He also said that from the experience of other regions in China, there are many factors that affect the results of nucleic acid testing, such as the sensitivity of the testing reagent, the time of infection and detoxification of the tested person, the cooperation of the tested person when the specimen is taken (poor cooperation may lead to the specimen not being taken in place), the testing environment, and the proficiency of the testing personnel.
ref: He also said that, as seen from the experience of other regions in China, the results of nucleic acid test are affected by many factors, such as the sensitivity of test reagents, the time of infection and detoxification of the tested persons, the cooperation of the tested persons when the specimens are taken (poor cooperation may result in the improper acquisition of specimens), as well as the test environment and the operational proficiency of test personnel.

src: 由于各种原因，核酸检测也会出现假阴性的结果。
mt: Due to various reasons, nucleic acid tests can also produce false negative results.
ref: False negative result will possibly appear in the nucleic acid test for various reasons.

src: 所谓假阴性，就是指受检测者确实是感染者，但是核酸检测结果却为阴性。
mt: The so - called false negative means that the person tested is indeed infected, but the nucleic acid test results are negative.
ref: So-called false negative refers to that a tested person is infected actually, but the result of his or her nucleic acid test is negative.

src: 另外，对于和确诊病例、疑似病例有过密切接触的人员，通常需要两次核酸检测才能排除。
mt: In addition, people who have been in close contact with confirmed and suspected cases usually need two nucleic acid tests to exclude them.
ref: In addition, two nucleic acid tests are usually required to rule out persons who have had close contact with confirmed or suspected cases.

src: 对于去过疫情中高风险地区的人员，如果出现发热和呼吸道症状，一次核酸检测阴性存在假阴性可能，所以也需要两次核酸检测才能排除。
mt: For people who have been to high - risk areas of the epidemic, if fever and respiratory symptoms occur, a negative nucleic acid test may lead to false negatives, so two nucleic acid tests are also needed to eliminate them.
ref: For persons who have been to medium- and high-risk areas of the pandemic, and have fever and respiratory symptoms, two nucleic acid tests are also required to rule them out since one nucleic acid test will possibly produce the result of false negative.

src: 他表示，鉴于以上情况，为了全市各族群众的身体健康，从今天开始，乌鲁木齐市将对天山区、沙依巴克区等重点地区进行二次免费核酸检测，同时开展“查遗补漏” 。
mt: He said that in view of the above situation, and for the sake of the health of the people of all ethnic groups in the city, Urumqi will conduct a second free nucleic acid test in key areas such as Tianshan District and Shaybak District from today, and at the same time carry out "checking heritage and filling gaps".
ref: He said that, in view of the above-mentioned situation, for the physical health of the people of all ethnic groups in the city, Urumqi will carry out secondary free nucleic acid test and develop “the check and supplement of omissions” in key areas such as Tianshan District and Shayibake District.

src: 据悉，天山区、沙依巴克区是疫情高风险地区。
mt: It is reported that Tianshan District and Shaybak District are high - risk areas for the epidemic.
ref: It’s learnt that Tianshan District and Shayibake District are high-risk areas of the pandemic.

src: 白宫疫情专家福奇：对2021年初研制出疫苗持谨慎乐观
mt: White House outbreak expert Fauci: Cautiously optimistic about vaccine development in early 2021
ref: White House epidemic expert Fauci: I am cautiously optimistic about the development of vaccines in early 2021

src: 福奇25日在国际领袖基金会主办的一场网络视频会议上作上述表示。
mt: Fauci made the remarks at an online video conference hosted by the International Leadership Foundation on the 25th.
ref: Fauci made the above remark at an online video conference hosted by the International Leadership Foundation on the 25th.

src: 他提醒说，目前尚不清楚新冠疫情在秋冬季将如何发展，也不知道疫情的最终影响会如何，“而结束这一切的唯一办法就是我们每个人都选择成为解决问题的一部分”。
mt: He cautioned that it is not clear how the new coronavirus outbreak will develop in autumn and winter, nor what the ultimate impact of the epidemic will be, "and the only way to end all this is for each of us to choose to be part of the solution."
ref: He reminded that it was not clear how the COVID-19 epidemic would develop in autumn and winter, nor what the final impact of the COVID-19 epidemic would be, but "the only way to end all this is for each of us to choose to be part of the solution".

src: 据美国约翰斯·霍普金斯大学数据，截至25日21时，美国新冠确诊病例已达417.6万，死亡14.6万人。
mt: According to Johns Hopkins University, as of 21:00 on the 25th, the number of confirmed new coronavirus cases in the United States has reached 4.176,000, with 146,000 deaths.
ref: According to the data from the Johns Hopkins University of the United States, as of 21: 00 on the 25th, there were 4.176 million confirmed cases and 146,000 deaths in COVID-19.

src: 福奇表示，美国一些地区目前正在艰难地同反弹的疫情作斗争。
mt: Fauci said that some parts of the United States are currently struggling with the rebound of the pandemic.
ref: Fauci said that some areas in the United States were struggling to fight against the rebounding COVID-19 epidemic.

src: 尽管各地疫情有所不同，需要因地制宜的应对方案，但多样化的抗疫策略并不意味着地区之间没有紧密联系。
mt: Although the epidemic situation varies from region to region and needs to be adapted to local conditions, diverse anti - epidemic strategies do not mean that there is no close connection between regions.
ref: Although the epidemic varies from place to place, it is necessary to develop solutions depending on the local conditions, but diversified anti-epidemic strategies do not mean that there is no close connection between regions.

src: 一个地区的疫情最终会影响到其他地区。
mt: Outbreaks in one region will eventually affect other regions.
ref: The epidemic in one region will eventually affect other regions.

src: “现在不是自满的时候”，福奇说，“我们的工作没有完成，必须加紧努力，也必须对未来的不确定性保持警惕。”
mt: "Now is not the time for complacency," Fauci said. "Our work has not been completed, we must step up our efforts, and we must be vigilant about the uncertainty of the future."
ref: "Now is not the time for complacency," Fauci said, and "our work has not been completed, we must step up our efforts, and we must be vigilant against the uncertainty in the future.  ”

src: 美国华裔医学专家、治疗艾滋病“鸡尾酒疗法”创始人何大一在会上指出，美国新冠疫情尚未到达顶峰。
mt: He Dayi, a Chinese - American medical expert and founder of "cocktail therapy" for the treatment of AIDS, pointed out at the meeting that the new coronavirus outbreak in the United States has not yet reached its peak.
ref: He Dayi, an American Chinese medical expert and founder of "cocktail therapy" for treating AIDS, pointed out at the meeting that the COVID-19 epidemic in the United States had not yet reached its peak.

src: “我们每个人都必须尽自己的一份力来减缓这一病毒的传播。”
mt: "Each of us must do our part to slow down the spread of this virus."
ref: "Each of us must do our part to slow down the spread of this virus.  ”

src: 何大一呼吁，公众用自己的实际行动为科学家争取时间，以加紧研发新冠治疗药物和疫苗。
mt: He called on the public to use their practical actions to buy time for scientists to step up research and development of new coronavirus therapeutics and vaccines.
ref: He Dayi called on the public to use their practical actions to buy time for scientists to step up research and development of the therapeutic drugs and vaccines for COVID-19.

src: 国际领袖基金会是一家以促进美国及亚太地区国际交流活动为宗旨的非营利性组织，致力于提升美国亚太裔地位，培育国际青年领袖。
mt: The International Leadership Foundation is a non - profit organization dedicated to promoting international exchange activities in the United States and the Asia - Pacific region, and is committed to elevating the status of Asian - Pacific Americans and cultivating young international leaders.
ref: The International Leadership Foundation is a non-profit organization aiming at promoting the international exchange activities in the United States and Asia-Pacific region, and is committed to promoting the status of Asian-Pacific Americans and cultivating international young leaders.

src: 当天，美国运输部长赵小兰、美联邦众议员孟昭文以及国际领袖基金会创会会长董继玲等分别在会上发言。
mt: On the same day, U.S. Secretary of Transportation Elaine Chao, U.S. Representative Meng Zhaowen, and founding president of the International Leadership Foundation Dong Jiling spoke at the meeting.
ref: On the same day, Zhao Xiaolan, minister of the United States Department of Transportation, Grace Meng, member of United States House of Representatives, and Dong Jiling, founding president of the International Leadership Foundation, etc., spoke at the meeting respectively.

src: 他们特别向在一线抗疫的亚太裔医务工作者和志愿者致敬，并呼吁美国公众继续坚持“社交距离”等防疫准则，遏制疫情扩散。
mt: They paid special tribute to the Asian - Pacific medical workers and volunteers fighting the epidemic on the front line, and called on the American public to continue to adhere to epidemic prevention guidelines such as "social distancing" to contain the spread of the epidemic.
ref: They paid special tribute to the Asian-Pacific medical workers and volunteers who fought the epidemic in the front line, and called on the American public to continue to adhere to the epidemic prevention guidelines such as "keeping social distance" to curb the spread of the epidemic.

src: 美中贸谈代表 传8月会面
mt: U.S. - China Trade Talks Representatives Transcript for Meeting in August
ref: U.S. - China trade talks representatives rumored to meet in August

src: 香港《南华早报》25日引述一名匿名知情人士报导，中国贸易谈判团队负责人、国务院副总理刘鹤与美方团队共同领导人、贸易代表赖海哲可望在8月举行正式会谈，评估双方履行中美第一阶段贸易协议的情况。
mt: Hong Kong's South China Morning Post quoted an anonymous person familiar with the matter as saying that Liu He, the head of the Chinese trade negotiation team and Vice Premier of the State Council, and Lai Haizhe, the co - leader of the US team and trade representative, are expected to hold formal talks in August to assess the implementation of the first phase of the China - US trade agreement.
ref: Hong Kong's South China Morning Post reported on the 25th August by citing an anonymous source familiar with the matter that Liu He, the head of China's trade negotiation team and the Vice Premier of the State Council, and Robert Lighthizer, the co-leader of the U.S. team and Trade Representative, are expected to hold formal talks in August to assess the two sides' implementation of the first phase of the U.S.-China trade agreement.

src: 报导说，虽然中国过去几个月已大幅提高采购美国农产品数量，但因新冠病毒疫情等因素，中方采购量距离贸易协议中承诺的数量仍有一段距离。
mt: The report said that although China has significantly increased its purchases of U.S. agricultural products in the past few months, due to the new coronavirus outbreak and other factors, China's purchases are still some way from the amount promised in the trade agreement.
ref: According to the report, China has significantly increased its purchases of U.S. agricultural products in the past few months, but because of the COVID-19 pandemic and other factors, Chinese purchases are still some distance away from the quantities promised in the trade agreement.

src: 分析家说，近来美中相互关闭对方领事馆，加上其他争端，可能破坏双方在贸易方面的任何进展。
mt: Analysts say the recent closure of each other's consulates by the United States and China, together with other disputes, could derail any progress on trade between the two sides.
ref: Analysts said that the closure of each other's consulates by the U.S. and China and their other disputes could derail any progress on trade between the two sides.

src: 中美第一阶段贸易协议在1月15日签署后一个月生效，协议中规定双方高层组成的贸易框架小组，每半年应举行一次会谈。
mt: The first phase of the trade agreement between China and the United States came into force one month after its signing on January 15, and the agreement stipulates that the high - level trade framework group of the two sides should hold talks every six months.
ref: The first phase of the U.S.-China trade agreement, which took effect one month after it was signed on Jan. 15, stipulates that a trade framework group composed of high-level officials from both sides should hold talks once every six months.

src: 知情人士透露，此次会议将是“一个重要的转折点”，让双方得以评估协议进展。
mt: Informed sources said the meeting would be "an important turning point", allowing both sides to assess the progress of the agreement.
ref: A source close to the matter said that, the meeting will be "an important turning point" for the two sides to assess the progress of the agreement.

src: 但这名人士也说，若美中紧张关系导致此时会谈意愿不高，双方可能会同意，赖海哲与刘鹤5月8日的电话会议，即已满足贸易协议中每半年会谈一次的条款。
mt: However, this person also said that if tensions between the United States and China lead to a low willingness to talk at this time, the two sides may agree that the conference call between Lai Haizhe and Liu He on May 8 has met the semi - annual terms of the trade agreement.
ref: But the source also said that if U.S. - China tensions lead to a low willingness to talk at this time, the two sides may agree that the conference call between Lai Haizhe and Liu He on May 8, which meets the terms of the trade agreement to hold talks once every six months.

src: 今年以来，中美关系急速恶化，双方争端包括新冠病毒起源、贸易、香港、新疆、南海与意识形态等一系列问题。
mt: Since the beginning of this year, China - US relations have deteriorated rapidly, with disputes between the two sides including the origin of the new coronavirus, trade, Hong Kong, Xinjiang, the South China Sea, and ideology.
ref: Since this year, the China-US relations have deteriorated sharply, and the disputes between the two sides cover a range of issues such as the origin of novel coronavirus, trade, Hong Kong, Xinjiang, the South China Sea and ideology.

src: 美国总统特朗普虽在年初吹嘘自己在首阶段协议中取得的成就，但近来态度改变。
mt: Although US President Donald Trump bragged about his achievements in the first phase of the agreement at the beginning of the year, his attitude has recently changed.
ref: U.S. President Trump has changed his attitude recently, despite boasting about his achievements in the first phase of the agreement earlier in the year.

src: 他23日在白宫记者会上说，虽然中国近来单日采购美国玉米数量破纪录，也买了很多大豆，“但这份贸易协议现在对我的意义，已不如当初达成时” 。
mt: He said at the White House press conference on the 23rd that although China has recently purchased a record amount of U.S. corn and bought a lot of soybeans in a single day, "this trade agreement is no longer as meaningful to me as it was when it was reached".
ref: He said at a White House press conference on the 23rd day that, China’s single-day purchase of U.S. corn has broken the record, and also, China has bought a lot of soybeans recently, "but now, this trade agreement means less to me than it did when it was reached."

src: 一位匿名北京政府顾问也认为，由于美中关系不佳，新一轮贸易谈判不太可能进行， “贸易议题在中美关系已失去分量”。
mt: An anonymous Beijing government adviser also said that due to the poor relationship between the United States and China, a new round of trade negotiations is unlikely, and that "trade issues have lost weight in China - US relations".
ref: An anonymous adviser from Beijing Government also believes that a new round of trade talks is unlikely due to poor U.S.-China relations and that "the issue of trade has lost its weight in the China-U.S. relations."

src: 但他透露，中国经贸相关单位23日仍开会讨论了一系列问题，包括如何增加从美国的进口量， “我们已经尽力买了，所以任何追加采购会有困难” 。
mt: However, he revealed that the relevant Chinese economic and trade units still met on the 23rd to discuss a series of issues, including how to increase imports from the United States, "We have tried our best to buy, so any additional purchases will be difficult".
ref: But he revealed that China's relevant economic and trade units still met on the 23rd day to discuss a range of issues, including how to increase imports from the U.S. "We have done our best to buy, so any additional purchases will be difficult".

src: 美中贸易全国委员会副会长彭捷宁表示，保持首阶段协议动能“比以往任何时候都更重要”， 并指中国今年在进一步向美企开放金融市场上有所进展。
mt: Peng Jining, vice president of the U.S. - China Trade National Committee, said that it is "more important than ever" to maintain the momentum of the first phase of the agreement, and pointed out that China has made progress in further opening its financial markets to U.S. companies this year.
ref: Jake Parker, the Vice President of the U.S.-China Business Council, said it is "more important than ever" to maintain the momentum of the first phase of the agreement, and that China has made progresses this year in further opening its financial markets to U.S. companies.

src: 独立研究公司Plenum分析师说 ：“谈比不谈好，尽管可能只被当成例行公事。”
mt: Analysts at Plenum, an independent research firm, said, "It is better to talk than not talk, although it may only be regarded as routine."
ref: An analyst from Plenum, an independent research firm, said, "It's better to hold talks than not to do so, even though it may only be treated as routine. ”

src: 余额宝收益下行“90后”反而“报复性”存钱？
mt: Yuanbao's income declined after the "90s, but instead" retaliated "to save money?
ref: Yu Ebao's Revenue Declines, But "Post-90s" to Save Money "in a Retaliatory Way"?

src: 随着余额宝收益下行， “90后”不仅没有逃离余额宝，反而开始“报复性”存钱了？
mt: As the income of Yuanbao declined, the "post-90s" not only did not flee Yuanbao, but began to save money "vindictively"?
ref: With the decline in the income from Yu Ebao, the "post-90s" did not only escape from it, but began to save money in a "retaliatory" manner?

src: 中国新经济研究院联合支付宝日前发布的《余额宝90后攒钱报告 》（2020版）显示，上半年，“90后”更爱攒钱了：人均攒钱金额比2019年增长近四成。
mt: In the first half of the year, the "post-90s" were more likely to save money: the amount of money saved per capita increased by nearly 40% compared to 2019, according to the 2020 edition of the Balance Bao Savings Report released by the China New Economy Research Institute and Alipay.
ref: The "Report on Yu Ebao Savings of Post-90s" (2020 version) recently released by the China Institute of New Economics and Alipay shows that in the first half of the year, "post-90s" love to save money more than before: the average amount of money saved per capita has increased by nearly 40% compared to that of 2019.

src: 有意思的是，“90后”更倾向于从一笔笔“小钱”开始攒，有六成平均每笔攒钱金额在20元以下… …
mt: Interestingly, the "post-90s" are more inclined to save from a single stroke of "small money", with 60% saving less than 20 yuan per stroke on average...
ref: What’s interesting is that "post-90s" tend to start saving from “small amounts”, and 60% of the savings are less than RMB20 each...

src: 用余额宝攒钱，也成为“90后”的攒钱习惯。
mt: Saving money with balance treasure has also become the saving habit of the "post-90s".
ref: Saving money with Yu Ebao has also become the habit of saving money for "post-90s".

src: 数据显示，在7亿余额宝用户中，有1.34亿用户是“90后” 。
mt: Data shows that of the 700 million Yuanbao users, 134 million are "post-90s".
